lines.speaker: ansel
lines.text: Ansel, Commons assembly. We run this town by argument. It is slower than an algorithm and it is ours.

lines.speaker: ansel
lines.text: The assembly voted to keep the blades on the memorial wall instead of melting them down. Somebody has to remember that people fought for this.

lines.speaker: ansel
lines.text: You sound like you have made your peace with the Steward. Some of us have. The rest of us keep the assembly meeting anyway.

lines.speaker: ansel
lines.text: Every era has its own money and none of it travels. Relics are the exception: old things, made things. Any shop pays for them. Carry five at most.
